Defeat the final opponent of [[the Norn Fighting Tournament]].

==Quest information==

===Objectives===
*Defeat [[Magni the Bison]] and claim victory in his tournament.
*See Magni the Bison for your reward.

===Reward===
* 150 [[Norn reputation point]]s
* {{skill icon|A Touch of Guile}}
* {{skill icon|"Dodge This!"}}
* {{skill icon|"Finish Him!"}}
* [[The Bison Cup]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Magni the Bison'''
:''"'''[Difficulty: Master] [Solo Quest] '''You have climbed the '''tournament''' ladder, stepping on those beneath you to reach the top. Now '''defeat me''', the greatest warrior in [[Norn]] history...if you can! Only then will you earn my respect! Otherwise you are just another insect waiting to be crushed under my boot!"''

===Intermediate dialogue===
;Magni the Bison
:''"At last, you have earned the right to face me. Long have I waited for a true challenge. Do not disappoint me." 

:''"You thought you could best me? Me? Fool! I am the greatest!"'' (If Magni defeats you.)

:''"Is this what it feels like...to lose?"'' (If you defeat Magni.)

===Reward dialogue===
'''Magni the Bison'''
:''"I cannot believe it! You have done the impossible! Magni the Bison is defeated! How I have dreamed of this day...to finally face my equal. Now that I have tasted defeat, I feel reborn. Alive! This loss shall spur me on to even greater feats! My tournament will continue. I must find more worthy opponents to drive my greatness ever onward. I hope to face you again some day."''

==Notes==
*This quest is automatically accepted upon completing the preceding quest (that is, winning the round 5 of the tournament).
*Unlike the other quests in this quest chain, this one is ''not'' [[repeatable quest|repeatable]]. Once a character wins the Norn Fighting Tournament, the next time this quest chain is started, this quest will be replaced by [[Final Round, Championship Edition: Fight!]] instead.
